description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Physical Mutation

You grow a spider-like drone no bigger than a fist that can crawl out of a cavity on your body in search of prey. The drone has @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.8slW8CJ2oVTxeQ6q]{Size} (Tiny), Movement 2, Agility 30, Stealth 40, Melee (Grapple) 30, Dodge 30, the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.KII1gWnxIZ8HzmU5]{Wallcrawler} Creature Trait and dies if it sustains 1 Wound. You are in telepathic control of the drone and it can move Willpower yards away from you. I you are more separated than that it becomes inert until you are close again. If the drone dies you can grow a new one over a month. If the drone comes in contact with the head of a humanoid or beast (but not a monster, daemon or undead), it can attempt to inject a needle-like tentacle through the neck, an eye or an ear, into the brain of the victim. If the victim is awake and resisting the drone must succeed with two Opposed Grapple Tests. Sleeping victims only require one Opposed Grapple Test and unresisting (bound, unconscious, drugged..) require none. The victim may try to hit the drone, but any missed attack will hit themselves. Once the drone makes contact with the victims brain it assumes total control over its physical faculties. The victim remains conscious, but must succeed with a Hard (-20) Willpower Test to do any Action. It only has one attempt per scene. If the victim survives being controlled by the drone it receives -2D10 Willpower.
